content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Family Court Lakhimpur Kheri Counselor Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://kheri.dcourts.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 06-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Family Court Lakhimpur Kheri Counselor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Counselor post is 06 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Counselor position in the Family Court Lakhimpur Kheri Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 35 years, and the maximum age limit is 65 years for the Counselor position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Counselor role?
faq.answer: Candidates should be Graduates in Sociology or Psychology with experience in social service. A Master's in Social Work with 2 years of family counseling experience is preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Counselor position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 1000 per working day or Rs. 24000 per month, whichever is less, for the Counselor post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny by the State Government, preparation of a candidate list, consultation with a High Court expert, recommendation by the High Court, and final notification by the State Government.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for the Family Court Lakhimpur Kheri Counselor Recruitment 2026 must be submitted in offline mode via post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for more information and to download the application form?
faq.answer: The official website for Family Court Lakhimpur Kheri is https://kheri.dcourts.gov.in. Candidates can download the application form from here.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are generally required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Typically, you will need to attach self-attested copies of your photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational/experience certificates as per the instructions in the official notification.
